### Technical Summary: Spaced Repetition Systems (SRS)

Spaced repetition is the algorithmic management of the "forgetting curve." At its core, the goal is to schedule reviews at the optimal intervals to maximize long-term retention while minimizing cognitive load. Modern SRS implementations rely on three primary technical pillars:
